topic_en: Solve the initial value problem y double prime plus three y prime plus two y equals zero, with y of zero equals one and y prime of zero equals zero. First, write down the ODE and initial conditions. Second, form the characteristic equation r squared plus three r plus two equals zero. Third, factor as r plus one times r plus two equals zero. Fourth, find the roots r equals negative one and r equals negative two. Fifth, write the general solution y of t equals C one e to the minus t plus C two e to the minus two t. Sixth, apply y of zero equals one to get C one plus C two equals one. Seventh, apply y prime of zero equals zero to get negative C one minus two C two equals zero. Eighth, solve the linear system to get C one equals two and C two equals negative one. Ninth, write the particular solution y of t equals two e to the minus t minus e to the minus two t. Tenth, plot y of t showing smooth decay to zero.
topic_zh: 解二階常微分方程 y''+3y'+2y=0，初值 y(0)=1, y'(0)=0

from manim import *
import numpy as np


class MainScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#0e1116"

        # ---------- Title ----------
        title = Text("Solving an Initial Value Problem", color=YELLOW, weight=BOLD).scale(0.8)
        underline = Line(LEFT, RIGHT, color=YELLOW).set_width(title.width + 0.4)
        underline.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.15)
        title_grp = VGroup(title, underline).to_edge(UP, buff=0.4)
        self.play(Write(title), GrowFromCenter(underline))
        self.wait(0.5)

        # ---------- Step 1: ODE + ICs ----------
        ode = MathTex("y'' + 3y' + 2y = 0", color=WHITE).scale(1.1)
        ics = MathTex("y(0)=1,\\quad y'(0)=0", color=BLUE_B).scale(0.9)
        ode.next_to(title_grp, DOWN, buff=0.7)
